summary: Ten planning and browsing operations retire from the agent surface: domain active_work, observation record and dismiss, relate link, unlink, supersede, and restore_superseded, product_view portfolio, work_compact lesson_publish, and knowledge unprocessed. Relation writing keeps three scoped writers: resolve_overlap with its five kinds and per-kind approval, capture raised_from with the work item's creation, and the workflow link_successor forward_link. Lessons publish through a reviewed pull request, the unprocessed negative is resolve_note knowledge_missing, the Domain list, detail, attachments, and overlaps reads remain with observation rows readable, and relation kinds stay closed and relation changes write current rows. CD-0068 is superseded; the Product-row glance contract C14 retires by deletion with its read, and no C14 statement governs a live surface.
title: Ten planning and browsing operations are retired from the agent surface
